title: UBDS Manufacturer Index — v1
description: One file per distinct vendor under manufacturers/<slug>.yaml. The slug is kebab-case and equals the filename stem. canonical_name is the vendor's own self-name (verified against their homepage); aliases capture short-forms and historical names so board YAMLs can match by either.

slug.description: Kebab-case slug; must equal the filename stem and the pattern in ubds-v1.schema.json#/properties/manufacturer_slug.

canonical_name.description: Vendor's official self-name as it appears on their homepage. Not a reseller, distributor, or affiliate name.

aliases.description: Short-forms, historical names, and stylings the vendor uses or the community recognizes. Compared case-insensitively + whitespace-collapsed across the directory.

homepage_url.description: Vendor's primary homepage URL (used to verify canonical_name).

country_code.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the vendor's HQ; optional.

well_known.description: If true, the manufacturer is grandfathered into the orphan-add rule (the 14 vendors named in the C22 ubds-spec-revision handoff §6). New non-well-known manufacturers must have at least one referencing board to be accepted.
